briefdescription.para: Internal (not installed): RAII ownership and exception-safe callbacks for the GSL solvers (C1, LIB-02/18, LIB-27).

detaileddescription.para: Valid results are unchanged: the bracket check evaluates f(lower), f(upper) in GSL's order, and GSL's own evaluation of the same endpoints in gsl_root_fsolver_set is served from that result, so the sequence of function evaluations is identical to the unguarded code. Hybrid (multiroot) solvers keep their non-finite and non-convergence behaviour; only callback exceptions are contained there. Not preventable without a handler: GSL's allocation failures (GSL_ENOMEM) in *_alloc.
